plugins.name: Note queries
plugins.author: Cairn
plugins.description: Live lists and tables of notes from a query code block: filter by type, status, tag, folder or text, sort and limit. Dataview for everyday questions.

plugins.name: Calendar
plugins.author: Cairn
plugins.description: A month calendar of your journal. See which days have entries and what you created; click a day to open or start it.

plugins.name: Writing stats
plugins.author: Cairn
plugins.description: Words written, notes per type, your longest notes and a 30-day activity chart. Adds a word-count command for the open note.

plugins.name: Recent files
plugins.author: Cairn
plugins.description: Remembers the notes you open and lists them newest first, with a command to jump back to the last one.
